bugs.error_message: VPS docker compose up -d: caddy container fails, Caddyfile mounted as directory
bugs.root_cause: The host Caddy serves certrace8 via /etc/caddy/certrace8.caddy; the compose caddy service has no Caddyfile on the VPS, so Docker created an empty directory.
bugs.fix: Deploy with `docker compose up -d backend frontend` (migrate runs via depends_on). If caddy was created: rmdir the empty Caddyfile dir and `docker compose rm -f caddy`.

bugs.error_message: Admin marking an evidence file reviewed made a pending pre-verification stale
bugs.root_cause: reviewFile went through mutate(), which always bumps the workbook revision; the submission compares its workbook_revision to the current one.
bugs.fix: mutate(..., bump=false) for reviewFile. Customer tab sees the green dot only after reload or its next edit.

bugs.error_message: Windowed spreadsheet spacer measured 0px height in the browser pane

bugs.fix: In headless/hidden-pane checks inject *{transition:none!important} before measuring.
